title: Chip stocks: Micron fell 5.83% while Apple and Microsoft closed green
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

The S&P 500 finished August 24 down 0.17 percent. A quiet session on the surface.

Underneath it, memory broke on its own. Micron closed at 910.43, down 5.83 percent. Apple, Microsoft and Google averaged plus 0.70 percent the same day.

That is a gap of 6.53 points in one session. We measured every session since January 2021, 1,415 of them. The median gap is plus 0.05 points. This one sits in the 2nd percentile, and only 30 days out of 1,415 were this wide.

Reported that morning: a Chinese memory maker filed to list in Shanghai. We report what was written. We did not measure cause.

What the split shows is where the repricing landed, on the companies that make memory rather than the ones that buy it.

story.event: Micron fell 5.83% on August 24 while Apple, Microsoft and Google all closed higher and the S&P 500 was almost unchanged.
story.mechanism: The split fell along the line between the companies that make memory and the companies that buy it, which is where a new-supply story would land rather than a demand story. Coverage that morning carried a Chinese memory maker's Shanghai listing filing.

insight.claim: The one-day gap between Micron and the three megacaps reached -6.53 points against a five-year median of +0.05, the 2nd percentile of 1,415 sessions
